fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on local civic and political matters in Miami and Miami Beach, including criticism of banking practices and use of public funds, discussion of Florida Power & Light Company franchises and utility rates, and coverage of the Fred Osius automobile case and related questions of prosecution and public safety. Reports address Jackson Memorial Hospital administration and the firing of Dr. Lowry, Miami Beach police matters, the closing of the Floridian Hotel, and debates over airport location (Dinner Key versus Chapman Field). Also includes late news briefs (including Tamiami Trail/oil drilling and Florida East Coast Railway), financial statements and bank condition reports, and sports coverage and advertisements for boxing matches.
